question: A/an ______ is a natural geo-hydrological unit of land, which collects water and drains it through a common point by a system of streams.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Watershed**__.

__
 
• A/an** watershed** is a natural **geo-hydrological unit of land,** which collects water and drains it through a common point by a system of streams.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **A Watershed** is defined as a** geohydrological unit** draining to a common point by a system of **drains.**
